name: bioflow
description: BioFlow — Your Health. Your History. Your Control.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bioflow/web && npm run typecheck -w @bioflow/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bioflow/web && npm run typecheck -w @bioflow/api
scripts.build:subpath: npm run build -w @bioflow/web && npm exec -w @bioflow/web -- vite build --base=/bioflow/ --outDir dist/bioflow && node scripts/build-sw.mjs bioflow
